Weather System: Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 14 September 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Pagbilao, Tayabas, Lucena, Sariaya, Candelaria) and Batangas(San Juan, Taysan, Lobo, Ibaan, Batangas City, Rosario).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

Light to moderate rains affecting Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna, Cavite, Bataan, Pampanga, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Balete, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Lipa, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Tuy, Padre Garcia), Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Sampaloc, Mauban, Real, Dolores, Padre Burgos, Atimonan, Unisan, Agdangan, Gumaca, Pitogo, Plaridel, Macalelon, General Luna, Alabat, Buenavista, Burdeos, Calauag, Catanauan, Guinayangan, Jomalig, Lopez, Mulanay, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Polillo, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, San Antonio, Tiaong, Lucban) and Zambales(San Marcelino, Subic, Castillejos, Olongapo) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
